mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.sort_order, m.visible, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.visible = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, icon, sort_order, visible, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{id}
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
